comment: Every configurable parameter in one file. The mass is drawn once per run from a weighted list (the transport knows a single mass, so sampleOnce is mandatory for anything but a fixed value); a seed-dependent drawn-once value cannot be known before the run, so prefer a fixed mass for production and derive the transport keys with MonopolesTransportKeys(). The energy and rapidity ranges have to be compatible with every mass the list can give: here etot >= 2000 >= 500*cosh(2), so no draw is ever rejected. A draw with etot < mass*cosh(y) is redrawn, which reshapes the configured distributions, so the generator warns when more than 1% are rejected and stops when no valid draw can be found.
